# Casos do varredor de vocabulário (lidos por tests/architecture.rs).
#
# Formato: tudo antes do primeiro marcador de caso é texto livre (este cabeçalho).
# Um caso começa numa linha que inicia com o marcador de arroba dupla seguido de espaço:
#
#     @@ <language> | <expectation> | <name>
#
# e vai até a linha anterior ao próximo marcador (ou o fim do arquivo). O corpo do
# caso é o código-fonte que o varredor recebe, sem nenhuma alteração.
#
#   <language>     rust ou sql (escolhe o varredor).
#   <expectation>  "clean" (nenhuma palavra acusada) ou "flags <w1>, <w2>" (o conjunto
#                  exato de palavras da lista de vocabulário que o varredor acusa).
#   <name>         texto livre, usado nas mensagens de falha.
#
# O arquivo não é compilado: o código Rust só precisa tokenizar, e o SQL só precisa
# ser texto. As linhas de cabeçalho começam com "#" para nunca virarem marcador.

@@ rust | flags check, gate | identifier in snake_case
fn check_gate() {}

@@ rust | flags gate | identifier in CamelCase
struct GateId;

@@ rust | flags gate | identifier after an acronym
struct HTTPGateServer;

@@ rust | flags gate | raw identifier
fn f() { let r#gate = 1; }

@@ rust | flags work | work_item identifier is caught by the word work
fn f() { let work_item = 1; }

@@ rust | flags work | string literal
const NAME: &str = "work";

@@ rust | flags work | string literal in upper case
const NAME: &str = "WORK";

@@ rust | flags work | word between punctuation inside a literal
const NAME: &str = "a-work-b";

@@ rust | flags work | escaped newline right before the word
const NAME: &str = "\nwork";

@@ rust | flags work | escaped hex separator before the word
const NAME: &str = "a\x2dwork";

@@ rust | flags work | raw string
const NAME: &str = r#"work"#;

@@ rust | flags work | byte string
const NAME: &[u8] = b"work";

@@ rust | flags work | c string
const NAME: &core::ffi::CStr = c"work";

@@ rust | flags decisão | accented word is one word
const NAME: &str = "decisão";

@@ rust | flags check | Rust literal carrying DDL with CHECK
const DDL: &str = "CREATE TABLE t (x TEXT CHECK (x IN ('a','b')))";

@@ rust | flags work | argument of an attribute
#[error("work failed")]
struct E;

@@ rust | clean | word glued together by a line continuation
const NAME: &str = "ab\
                    work";

@@ rust | clean | forbidden word only as a prefix inside a longer accented word
const NAME: &str = "indecisão";

@@ rust | clean | line and block comments
// check gate work
/* check gate
   work */
fn ok() {}

@@ rust | clean | doc comments
/// check gate work
//! unit review
/** claude */
/*! omhl */
fn ok() {}

@@ rust | clean | names that merely contain a forbidden word
fn digit(workspace: u8, network: u8) -> u8 {
    let checked = 1;
    let gateway = 2;
    let unitary = 3;
    workspace + network + checked + gateway + unitary
}

@@ sql | flags gate | gate_id as a column
CREATE TABLE t (gate_id TEXT NOT NULL);

@@ sql | flags check | check_id as a column
CREATE TABLE t (check_id TEXT NOT NULL);

@@ sql | flags check | check as an index name (not followed by an opening parenthesis)
CREATE INDEX check ON t (a);

@@ sql | flags gate | forbidden word in a constraint name
CONSTRAINT gate_unique UNIQUE (a)

@@ sql | flags work | single quoted literal is scanned
CREATE TABLE t (a TEXT DEFAULT 'work');

@@ sql | flags work | comment marker inside a literal does not start a comment
CREATE TABLE t (a TEXT DEFAULT '-- work');

@@ sql | clean | CHECK constraint with an IN list
CREATE TABLE t (x TEXT CHECK (x IN ('a','b')));

@@ sql | clean | lower case check glued to the parenthesis
CREATE TABLE t (kind TEXT check(kind IN ('a')));

@@ sql | clean | CHECK with the parenthesis on the next line
CREATE TABLE t (kind TEXT CHECK
    (kind IN ('a')));

@@ sql | clean | named constraint
CREATE TABLE t (kind TEXT, CONSTRAINT valid_kind CHECK (kind IN ('a')));

@@ sql | clean | line and block comments
-- gate_id
/* check
   work */
CREATE TABLE t (a TEXT); -- review

@@ sql | clean | columns that merely contain a forbidden word
CREATE TABLE t (checked_at TEXT, workspace TEXT, gateway TEXT);
